passages.title: Remote work and the junior employee
passages.text: When firms first sent employees home in 2020, many managers predicted a collapse in output. The collapse never came. Studies covering tens of thousands of workers found that routine tasks were completed slightly faster at home, largely because commutes disappeared and meetings shrank. Yet the same studies reported a quieter problem: employees in their first two years of work learned more slowly. Sitting near experienced colleagues, they had absorbed judgement by watching it being exercised. Video calls transmit information but not atmosphere, and a junior hire who does not know what to ask cannot ask it. Some firms now answer with hybrid weeks in which teams gather for the tasks that require judgement and disperse for the tasks that require concentration.

paragraphs.zh: 现象：远程办公没有让产出崩塌，常规任务反而略快。
转折：但入职两年内的员工学得更慢，因为缺少「旁观判断」的机会。
应对：混合办公——需要判断的事聚在一起，需要专注的事各自分散。

vocab.note: The collapse never came：预言中的下滑并未出现
absorb judgement 译「习得判断力」，不是「吸收判断」
transmit information but not atmosphere：传递信息但不传递氛围
hybrid weeks 指部分到岗、部分远程的工作周
与 gather 对举，指团队各自散开

sentences.en: Studies covering tens of thousands of workers found that routine tasks were completed slightly faster at home, largely because commutes disappeared and meetings shrank.
sentences.main: Studies found that routine tasks were completed slightly faster.
sentences.mods: covering… 现在分词作后置定语修饰 Studies；that 引导宾语从句；largely because… 原因状语从句，说明「为什么略快」。
sentences.zh: 覆盖数万名员工的研究发现，常规任务在家完成得略快，主要原因是通勤消失、会议缩短。
sentences.point: 细节题定位句。found that 后是结论，because 后是原因，命题常把两者拆开，问「原因是什么」。

sentences.en: Sitting near experienced colleagues, they had absorbed judgement by watching it being exercised.
sentences.main: they had absorbed judgement.
sentences.mods: Sitting… 现在分词作方式状语；by watching… 方式状语；being exercised 现在分词被动，作 watching 的宾补。
sentences.zh: 坐在有经验的同事身边，他们通过观察判断力如何被运用而习得了这种判断力。
sentences.point: 翻译题原句。分词状语要译成「坐在……身边」，being exercised 要转成主动「如何被运用」。

sentences.en: Video calls transmit information but not atmosphere, and a junior hire who does not know what to ask cannot ask it.
sentences.main: Video calls transmit information but not atmosphere, and a junior hire cannot ask it.
sentences.mods: who 引导定语从句修饰 hire；what to ask 作 know 的宾语；it 指 the question。
sentences.zh: 视频通话传递信息，却不传递氛围；而一个不知道该问什么的初级员工，也无从问起。
sentences.point: 推断题依据。but not 是显性对比，cannot ask it 是隐性结果，二者合起来说明「氛围缺失导致学得慢」。

questionMap.locate: 题干关键词是 routine tasks 与 completed，回原文找同义表达，定位在第二句的 slightly faster
问原因，定位到 learned more slowly 之后那句「靠旁观判断被行使来吸收」，把它译成选项
态度题看结尾段的评价：Some firms now answer with… 是正面回应问题的做法，语气克制

takeaway: 主旨：远程办公保住了常规产出，却削弱了新人「旁观学习」的机会，混合办公是对这一取舍的回应。
命题手法：用 studies found 引结论、用 although/but 设限定，正确项多是限定后的版本。
易错点：把「远程效率略高」扩大成「远程全面更好」，忽略 junior 这一段的反例。

falseFriends.note: meetings shrank：不是「会议缩水」，而是时长变短
a junior hire：此处 hire 指被雇用的人
absorb judgement：靠观察养成判断力，不是「吸收判断」

synonyms.to: the ability to make sound decisions

passages.title: Why city trees are health infrastructure
passages.text: City trees are usually discussed as decoration. A growing body of medical evidence suggests they should be discussed as infrastructure. Researchers tracking thousands of residents found that people living within a short walk of mature trees reported lower stress and slept longer, even after income and noise were taken into account. The effect was strongest in the hottest months, when shade lowered surface temperatures by several degrees. None of this makes trees a substitute for clinics. It does mean that a decision to remove a row of trees for a wider road is a health decision, and should be costed as one. A few cities have begun to do exactly that, listing the medical savings alongside the construction costs in their planning documents.

paragraphs.zh: 立论：城市树木常被当作装饰，医学证据支持把它当作基础设施。
证据：住得离成熟树木近的人压力更低、睡得更长，在最热的月份效果最强。
结论：砍树修路是健康决策，应把医疗节省计入工程成本；已有城市这么做。

vocab.note: 作者用它强调「应纳入公共成本核算」
mature trees 指成年大树，遮荫能力最强
shade lowered surface temperatures：树荫降低地表温度
a substitute for clinics：不能替代诊所
should be costed as one：按健康决策来核算

sentences.en: Researchers tracking thousands of residents found that people living within a short walk of mature trees reported lower stress and slept longer, even after income and noise were taken into account.
sentences.main: Researchers found that people reported lower stress and slept longer.
sentences.mods: tracking… 现在分词定语；living… 现在分词定语；even after… 让步状语从句，表示「排除混杂因素后仍成立」。
sentences.zh: 追踪数千名居民的研究者发现，住在离成熟树木几步之遥的人压力更低、睡眠更长，即便把收入和噪音因素考虑在内也是如此。
sentences.point: 细节题定位句。even after 是「结论可靠」的标志，选项若说「因为富人区树多」即被此句排除。

sentences.en: It does mean that a decision to remove a row of trees for a wider road is a health decision, and should be costed as one.
sentences.main: It does mean that a decision is a health decision and should be costed as one.
sentences.mods: does 表强调；to remove… 不定式作定语修饰 decision；for a wider road 目的状语；as one 中的 one 指 a health decision。
sentences.zh: 它确实意味着，为拓宽道路而砍掉一排树的决定是一个健康决策，并且应当按健康决策来核算成本。
sentences.point: 词义/态度题依据。作者用 infrastructure 不是比喻，而是主张「计入成本」，这句是直接证据。

sentences.en: A few cities have begun to do exactly that, listing the medical savings alongside the construction costs in their planning documents.
sentences.main: A few cities have begun to do that.
sentences.mods: listing… 现在分词作伴随状语；alongside… 介词短语说明并列关系。
sentences.zh: 少数城市已经开始这样做：在规划文件中把医疗节省与建设成本并列列出。
sentences.point: 末句作用题。exactly that 回指上一句的「按健康决策核算成本」，说明理念已落地。

questionMap.locate: 细节题，关键词 greatest 对应原文 strongest，定位到 the hottest months
词义/态度题：看作者用 infrastructure 想强调什么——后文说「砍树是健康决策，应计入成本」
末句作用题：A few cities have begun to do exactly that 中的 exactly that 指前一句的「把医疗节省计入成本」

takeaway: 主旨：树木不是装饰而是健康基础设施，砍树修路应按健康决策核算成本。
命题手法：先让步（不能替代诊所）再推进（但应计入成本），答案落在让步之后。
易错点：把 infrastructure 当成修辞，忽略作者「计入预算」的具体主张。

falseFriends.note: should be costed as one：按健康决策来计价
mature trees：树冠已成、遮荫能力最强的树
a row of trees：注意不是「争吵」

passages.title: The reproducibility problem in science
passages.text: Science advances by repetition: a result becomes knowledge when other laboratories obtain it too. In several fields, however, large replication projects have found that a substantial share of published findings cannot be reproduced. The causes are mundane rather than scandalous. Samples are small, analysis choices are flexible, and journals reward novelty over confirmation. A researcher who tries twenty statistical models and reports the one that worked is not lying, but the reported result is no longer an unbiased estimate. Reformers propose three remedies: register the analysis plan before collecting data, publish negative results, and fund replication as a normal part of research rather than as a curiosity.

paragraphs.zh: 背景：科学靠重复确立知识，但多个领域的大规模重复实验发现大量结果无法复现。
原因：样本小、分析选择多、期刊奖励新颖性——是平常做法，不是学术不端。
对策：预注册分析方案、发表阴性结果、把重复研究当作常规投入。

vocab.note: replication projects 重复性研究项目
findings cannot be reproduced 结果无法复现
mundane rather than scandalous：平常而非丑闻
an unbiased estimate 无偏估计
journals reward novelty over confirmation：重新颖轻验证

sentences.en: A researcher who tries twenty statistical models and reports the one that worked is not lying, but the reported result is no longer an unbiased estimate.
sentences.main: A researcher is not lying, but the result is no longer an unbiased estimate.
sentences.mods: who… 定语从句；that worked 定语从句修饰 the one；not… but… 构成转折。
sentences.zh: 一位尝试二十种统计模型、只报告其中奏效那一种的研究者并没有撒谎，但其所报告的结果已不再是无偏估计。
sentences.point: 例证题核心句。is not lying 排除「造假」选项，but 后才是作者真正的判断。

sentences.en: Reformers propose three remedies: register the analysis plan before collecting data, publish negative results, and fund replication as a normal part of research rather than as a curiosity.
sentences.main: Reformers propose three remedies.
sentences.mods: 冒号后三个并列动词短语作同位解释；rather than 对比「常规投入」与「猎奇」。
sentences.zh: 改革者提出三条补救措施：在收集数据前登记分析方案、发表阴性结果，以及把重复研究当作科研的常规部分而非猎奇之举。
sentences.point: 否定细节题出处。三条措施与选项一一对应，未出现的那一项才是答案。

sentences.en: The causes are mundane rather than scandalous.
sentences.main: The causes are mundane.
sentences.mods: rather than 引导对比成分，否定 scandalous。
sentences.zh: 这些原因是平常的，而非丑闻性的。
sentences.point: 定性句。凡是把原因归为「学者造假」的选项，都与这句直接冲突。

questionMap.locate: 细节题，关键词 causes 对应原文 The causes are mundane rather than scandalous，后面列举三点
例证题：例子服务于论点，看它前后一句——「不是撒谎，但结果不再是无偏估计」
否定细节题：把三个 remedy 与选项逐一对照，找未提及的那一项

takeaway: 主旨：大量结果无法复现，原因多是平常的研究做法与激励，而非造假；对策是预注册、发阴性结果、资助重复。
命题手法：定性句（mundane rather than scandalous）+ 三条并列措施，NOT 题就从这里出。
易错点：把「无法复现」直接等同于「学术不端」。

falseFriends.here: 阴性结果 / 未获支持的结果
falseFriends.note: publish negative results：指没做出显著差异的结果
mundane rather than scandalous：平常做法而非造假
rather than as a curiosity：不是可有可无的猎奇研究

synonyms.to: freedom to choose among statistical models

passages.title: What AI can and cannot do in diagnosis
passages.text: Systems trained on medical images can now detect certain cancers at least as accurately as specialist radiologists. Headlines often stop there. In practice the interesting questions begin afterwards. A model is calibrated on the population it was trained on; move it to a hospital with different equipment and its accuracy may fall sharply. It also reports a probability, not a reason, and clinicians are understandably reluctant to act on a number they cannot interrogate. The most promising deployments therefore place the model beside the doctor rather than in place of the doctor, using it to sort urgent cases and to flag images that deserve a second look.

paragraphs.zh: 现状：图像模型在部分癌症识别上已达专家水平，但新闻往往到此为止。
局限：换设备精度会掉；只给概率不给理由，医生不敢贸然采用。
出路：把模型放在医生身边做分诊与复核提示，而不是取代医生。

vocab.note: calibrated on the population 在特定人群上校准
accuracy may fall sharply 精度可能骤降
a number they cannot interrogate 无法追问的数字
the most promising deployments 最有前景的应用方式
flag images 标记影像

sentences.en: A model is calibrated on the population it was trained on; move it to a hospital with different equipment and its accuracy may fall sharply.
sentences.main: A model is calibrated; its accuracy may fall.
sentences.mods: it was trained on 是省略 which 的定语从句；move… and… 为「祈使句 + and」表条件。
sentences.zh: 模型是在它所训练的人群上校准的；把它搬到设备不同的医院，精度可能骤降。
sentences.point: 细节题依据。分号前后是「前提—后果」，选项若说「精度固定」即与此句矛盾。

sentences.en: It also reports a probability, not a reason, and clinicians are understandably reluctant to act on a number they cannot interrogate.
sentences.main: It reports a probability, and clinicians are reluctant.
sentences.mods: not a reason 对比；they cannot interrogate 是省略 which 的定语从句。
sentences.zh: 它给出的还是概率而非理由，临床医生不愿依据一个无法追问的数字行事，也在情理之中。
sentences.point: 因果链：只给概率 → 无法追问 → 不愿采纳。问「医生为何犹豫」时定位此句。

sentences.en: The most promising deployments therefore place the model beside the doctor rather than in place of the doctor, using it to sort urgent cases and to flag images that deserve a second look.
sentences.main: Deployments place the model beside the doctor.
sentences.mods: rather than 对比；using it 伴随状语；that deserve… 定语从句。
sentences.zh: 因此最有前景的部署方式，是把模型放在医生身边而非取代医生，用它分诊急症、标记值得复查的影像。
sentences.point: 主旨题依据。beside 与 in place of 的对立，就是「辅助」与「替代」的分界。

questionMap.locate: 细节题，关键词 accuracy 与 equipment，定位到 move it to a hospital with different equipment
问原因，定位 clinicians are understandably reluctant 所在句：reports a probability, not a reason
态度/主旨题，看结尾 the most promising deployments… beside the doctor rather than in place of the doctor

takeaway: 主旨：AI 读片精度已达专家水平，但换设备会掉点、只给概率不给理由，故应辅助而非替代医生。
命题手法：先承认优势，再用 in practice / however 转折列局限，主旨题考转折后的立场。
易错点：把 at least as accurately as 读成「永远更准」。

falseFriends.note: flag images：把影像标出来待复查
a number they cannot interrogate：无法追问依据的数字
sort urgent cases：按紧急程度分流

synonyms.to: instead of / as a replacement for

passages.title: Museums after the virtual tour
passages.text: When museums closed their doors, they put their collections online. Virtual tours attracted millions of visitors, and many institutions assumed they had found a new audience. The data tell a subtler story. Online visitors spend minutes, not hours, and rarely return; they behave like people browsing a shop window rather than like visitors. What the digital version does well is preparation and follow-up: a teacher can show a class a painting before a visit, and a visitor can look again at an object that caught the eye. Museums that treat the website as a substitute for the gallery are disappointed; those that treat it as a doorway are not.

paragraphs.zh: 现象：闭馆期间博物馆把藏品搬上网，虚拟参观吸引数百万人。
数据：线上访客只停留几分钟、很少回访，像逛橱窗而不是参观。
定位：数字版的优势在「参观前准备」和「参观后回看」，它是门口不是替代品。

vocab.note: a subtler story 更微妙的情况
browsing a shop window 逛橱窗
a substitute for the gallery 展厅的替代品
treat it as a doorway 把它当作入口
preparation and follow-up 行前准备与行后回看

sentences.en: Online visitors spend minutes, not hours, and rarely return; they behave like people browsing a shop window rather than like visitors.
sentences.main: Online visitors spend minutes and rarely return.
sentences.mods: not hours 对比；browsing… 现在分词定语；rather than 对比两种身份。
sentences.zh: 线上访客只停留几分钟而非几小时，且很少回访；他们的行为更像逛橱窗的人，而不像参观者。
sentences.point: 细节题依据。minutes / rarely return 是量化证据，直接否掉「黏性高」的选项。

sentences.en: What the digital version does well is preparation and follow-up: a teacher can show a class a painting before a visit, and a visitor can look again at an object that caught the eye.
sentences.main: What the digital version does well is preparation and follow-up.
sentences.mods: What 引导主语从句；冒号后两个例子分别对应 preparation 与 follow-up；that caught the eye 定语从句。
sentences.zh: 数字版真正擅长的是行前准备与行后回看：教师可以在参观前给班级展示一幅画，访客也可以再次端详一件曾吸引他的展品。
sentences.point: 细节题依据。冒号后是举例，答题时要能判断哪个选项属于「准备」、哪个属于「回看」。

sentences.en: Museums that treat the website as a substitute for the gallery are disappointed; those that treat it as a doorway are not.
sentences.main: Museums are disappointed; those are not.
sentences.mods: 两个 that 定语从句；those 指代 museums；it 指 the website。
sentences.zh: 把网站当作展厅替代品的博物馆会失望；把它当作入口的博物馆则不会。
sentences.point: 词义题依据。substitute 与 doorway 的对立，决定 doorway 应理解为「通向实体体验的入口」。

questionMap.locate: 细节题，关键词 online visitors，定位到 they behave like people browsing a shop window
细节题，关键词 most useful，定位 preparation and follow-up 一句，并注意冒号后的两个例子
词义题：doorway 与 substitute 对举，指「入口」——把人引向实体参观，而非取代它

takeaway: 主旨：线上展览不是实体参观的替代品，而是行前准备与行后回看的入口。
命题手法：数据（minutes, rarely return）+ 对比（substitute vs doorway），词义题就考这个对比。
易错点：被「数百万访问量」带走，忽视停留时长与回访率。

falseFriends.note: a subtler story：数据讲的是另一回事
browsing a shop window：只看不买式的观看
treat it as a doorway：把它当作进入实体体验的通道

passages.title: Sleep, memory and the cost of a short night
passages.text: Students have long treated sleep as a reserve to be spent before examinations. Laboratory work suggests this is a poor bargain. During deep sleep the brain replays patterns formed during the day, consolidating them into longer-term memory; cut the night short and the replay is cut short with it. In one experiment, participants who learned a list of words in the evening recalled more after a full night than after a half night, although the total study time was identical. The finding has an uncomfortable implication for schools that schedule early starts after late-night revision. Sleep is not time away from study; it is part of the process.

paragraphs.zh: 现象：学生把睡眠当作考前可透支的储备。
机制与实验：深睡重放白天的模式并巩固记忆；同样学习时间下，睡整夜者记得更多。
结论：睡眠不是学习之外的时间，而是学习过程的一部分。

vocab.note: a reserve to be spent 可支取的储备
consolidating them into longer-term memory 巩固为长期记忆
the brain replays patterns 大脑重放模式
the total study time was identical 学习总时长相同
an uncomfortable implication 令人不安的推论

sentences.en: During deep sleep the brain replays patterns formed during the day, consolidating them into longer-term memory; cut the night short and the replay is cut short with it.
sentences.main: The brain replays patterns; the replay is cut short.
sentences.mods: formed… 过去分词定语；consolidating… 伴随状语；cut… and… 条件句；with it 中的 it 指 the night。
sentences.zh: 在深度睡眠中，大脑会重放白天形成的模式，并将其巩固为长期记忆；若缩短夜间睡眠，重放也会随之缩短。
sentences.point: 机制句，也是翻译题原句。consolidating 要译成并列动作，不能译成定语。

sentences.en: In one experiment, participants who learned a list of words in the evening recalled more after a full night than after a half night, although the total study time was identical.
sentences.main: Participants recalled more.
sentences.mods: who 定语从句；than 比较结构；although 让步状语从句。
sentences.zh: 在一项实验中，晚上学习词表的参与者在睡满一夜后比只睡半夜后回忆得更多，尽管学习总时长完全相同。
sentences.point: 细节题依据。although 从句排除「他们学得更久」这一解释，是选项设置的分水岭。

sentences.en: Sleep is not time away from study; it is part of the process.
sentences.main: Sleep is not time away; it is part of the process.
sentences.mods: 分号连接两个并列分句，形成否定—肯定的定义式表达。
sentences.zh: 睡眠不是从学习中抽走的时间，它就是学习过程的一部分。
sentences.point: 主旨句。观点明确、无绝对化，适合作为 main idea 的答案依据。

questionMap.locate: 细节题，关键词 experiment 与 full night，定位 recalled more after a full night than after a half night
词义题：bargain 是「交易」，poor bargain 指「不划算」，后文用实验说明记忆收益反而下降

命题手法：机制句 + 控制变量的实验（although total study time was identical），结论句收束。
易错点：把「睡整夜记得多」解释成「他们学得更久」，忽略 although 从句。

the brain replays patterns：神经活动模式的重放

passages.title: Carbon labels and the limits of consumer choice
passages.text: Carbon labels on products are attractive because they promise to turn every purchase into a climate decision. Trials in several countries show that labels do change behaviour, but modestly: shoppers shift a few percentage points toward lower-carbon options, and the effect fades when the label competes with price. The deeper problem is arithmetic. A label informs one choice at a time, while emissions are determined by systems: how food is produced, how goods are transported, how buildings are heated. Expecting labels to deliver large reductions is like expecting a menu to improve a restaurant's kitchen. Labels are worth having, but they work best alongside rules that change what is on offer.

paragraphs.zh: 吸引力：碳标签让每次购买都像一次气候选择。
效果有限：只能让购买偏移几个百分点，遇到价格竞争就失效。
深层问题：排放由生产、运输、供暖等系统决定，标签只能影响单次选择，需与规则配合。

vocab.note: change behaviour, but modestly 有改变但幅度小
the effect fades 效果消退
The deeper problem is arithmetic 更深层是总量问题
deliver large reductions 带来大幅减排
work best alongside rules 与规则配合效果最好

sentences.en: Trials in several countries show that labels do change behaviour, but modestly: shoppers shift a few percentage points toward lower-carbon options, and the effect fades when the label competes with price.
sentences.main: Trials show that labels do change behaviour, but modestly.
sentences.mods: that 宾语从句；do 表强调；冒号后解释 modestly；when 时间/条件状语从句。
sentences.zh: 多国试验表明，标签确实改变了行为，但幅度有限：消费者会向低碳选项偏移几个百分点，而一旦标签与价格竞争，效果便消退。
sentences.point: 细节题依据。modestly 与 fades 是两个限定词，选项若说「效果显著且持久」即错。

sentences.en: Expecting labels to deliver large reductions is like expecting a menu to improve a restaurant's kitchen.
sentences.main: Expecting labels to deliver reductions is like expecting a menu to improve a kitchen.
sentences.mods: 两个动名词短语分别作主语和宾语；is like 构成明喻。
sentences.zh: 指望标签带来大幅减排，就像指望菜单去改善餐厅的厨房一样。
sentences.point: 类比题。menu 对应 label（信息），kitchen 对应 system（生产），类比的方向不能颠倒。

sentences.en: Labels are worth having, but they work best alongside rules that change what is on offer.
sentences.main: Labels are worth having, but they work best alongside rules.
sentences.mods: that 定语从句修饰 rules；what is on offer 宾语从句。
sentences.zh: 标签值得拥有，但它与「改变供给内容」的规则配合时效果最好。
sentences.point: 结论句。既肯定标签（worth having）又指出不足（alongside rules），答案应是「有用但不充分」。

questionMap.locate: 细节题，关键词 trials，定位 modestly 与 the effect fades when the label competes with price
类比题：menu 对应 label（信息），kitchen 对应 system（生产），菜单改不了厨房
结论题，看末句 Labels are worth having, but they work best alongside rules

takeaway: 主旨：碳标签能改变行为但幅度有限，排放由系统决定，标签需与改变供给的规则配合。
命题手法：让步（do change behaviour）+ 限定（but modestly）+ 类比（menu/kitchen）+ 结论（alongside rules）。
易错点：把「有效果」当成「效果显著」，忽略 modestly 与 fades。

falseFriends.note: The deeper problem is arithmetic：单次选择加起来仍不够
deliver large reductions：实现大幅减排
what is on offer：货架上有什么

passages.title: Gig work and the price of flexibility
passages.text: Platform work is praised for its flexibility: a driver can start at noon and stop at four. The flexibility is real, but it is not free. Because gig workers are classified as independent contractors, the platform does not contribute to insurance or retirement, and the worker bears the cost of idle time. Surveys find that hourly earnings, once these costs are subtracted, are often below those of comparable salaried jobs. Defenders reply that workers value the freedom to choose hours, and the surveys support this too. The policy question is therefore not whether flexibility is good, but who pays for it. A system that lets workers keep the flexibility while sharing the insurance cost would be both fairer and more stable.

paragraphs.zh: 说法：平台工作以灵活著称，司机可以中午开工、四点收工。
代价：按独立承包商归类，平台不缴保险与养老，空等成本由工人承担，折算时薪偏低。
政策问题：不是灵活好不好，而是谁为灵活付费；应保留灵活、分摊保险。

vocab.note: independent contractors 独立承包商
does not contribute to insurance 不缴保险
the cost of idle time 空等时间的成本
once these costs are subtracted 扣除这些成本后
portable insurance account 可随人转移的保险账户

sentences.en: Because gig workers are classified as independent contractors, the platform does not contribute to insurance or retirement, and the worker bears the cost of idle time.
sentences.main: The platform does not contribute, and the worker bears the cost.
sentences.mods: Because 原因状语从句；or 连接 insurance 与 retirement；bear the cost 为「承担成本」。
sentences.zh: 由于零工劳动者被归类为独立承包商，平台不为他们缴纳保险或养老，空等时间的成本也由劳动者自己承担。
sentences.point: 细节题依据。这句是「灵活不免费」的具体机制，成本转移的两个方向都在这里。

sentences.en: Surveys find that hourly earnings, once these costs are subtracted, are often below those of comparable salaried jobs.
sentences.main: Hourly earnings are often below those of salaried jobs.
sentences.mods: once… 条件状语从句作插入语；those 指 earnings。
sentences.zh: 调查发现，扣除这些成本后，小时收入往往低于可比的全职受薪岗位。
sentences.point: 数据依据。比较对象是 comparable salaried jobs，选项若扩大为「所有工作」即偷换范围。

sentences.en: A system that lets workers keep the flexibility while sharing the insurance cost would be both fairer and more stable.
sentences.main: A system would be both fairer and more stable.
sentences.mods: that 定语从句；while 表对比；both… and… 并列两个形容词比较级。
sentences.zh: 一种既让劳动者保留灵活性、又共同分摊保险成本的制度，会更公平也更稳定。
sentences.point: 政策建议句。问「作者建议什么」时，答案必须同时包含「保留灵活」和「分摊成本」两半。

questionMap.locate: 细节题，关键词 flexibility，定位 The flexibility is real, but it is not free，后文列出成本

takeaway: 主旨：零工的灵活性真实但非免费，保险与空等成本由工人承担；应保留灵活、分摊成本。
命题手法：先立（flexibility is real）后破（but not free），末句给政策主张。
易错点：把「工人重视自由」当成「零工没有问题」，两者在文中并存。
